% Synthetic fixture: the constructs a computation graph and a sketch of
% dots reach for — a tree grown upward with level styles, an edge style
% whose tips point at the parent, a child with no edge, a coordinate child,
% default child names an edge joins; a colour group around statements; a
% length macro, calc partway and factor steps, circles and an ellipse, a
% two-ended arrow and a size declaration among the statements, the tree's
% labels set at the size its picture's font= names. Invented content and
% design.
\documentclass{article}

\pictures{ tool = none }

\fonts{ dir = "fonts", body = "Source Serif Pro" }

\palette{
  leaf = #2A6F4E,
}

\title{Trees and Dots}
\author{Pat Placeholder}

\begin{document}

\maketitle

\section{A grown tree}

\begin{tikzpicture}[
  font=\small,
  level distance=12mm,
  level 1/.style={sibling distance=24mm},
  level 2/.style={sibling distance=14mm},
  edge from parent/.style={draw, latex-}
]
  \node (top) {sum} [grow=up]
    child {node {left}
      child {node {$p$}}
      child {node {$q$} edge from parent[draw=none]}}
    child {node {right}
      child {coordinate (tip)}};
  \draw[->] (top-1-1) -- (top-2);
  \textcolor{leaf}{\fill (tip) circle (2pt);}
\end{tikzpicture}

\section{Dots on a line}

\begin{tikzpicture}
  \pgfmathsetlengthmacro{\h}{0.6cm}
  \pgfmathsetlengthmacro{\r}{1.5pt}
  \coordinate (a) at (0,0);
  \coordinate (b) at ($(a) + 3*(\h,0)$);
  \coordinate (m) at ($(a)!.5!(b)$);
  \node[above] at (m) {mid};
  \draw (a) -- (b);
  \fill (a) circle (\r);
  \fill (b) circle (\r);
  \draw (m) ellipse (0.9 and 0.3);
  \draw[<->] ($(a) + (0,-\h)$) -- ($(b) + (0,-\h)$);
  {\footnotesize \node[below] at ($(a)!2!(m) + (0,-\h)$) {span};}
\end{tikzpicture}
